name: 310X
description: "A 4-speed record player with an auto-changer mechanism.A 4-pole synchronous motor is used for the turntable part.Equipped with mechanical queuing, it is easy to drop the needle to the desired position and to temporarily suspend the performance.It is designed to be jam proof and has improved durability.For example, if you move the arm carelessly while holding it in your hand, it will interfere with the interlocking mechanism or cause a locked object to fly away. The danger that is often seen with conventional auto players and auto-changers is prevented.The speed selector is designed to automatically turn off at the end of the performance without turning off the speed selector.At this time, the internal mechanism automatically returns to the neutral position even if the position is set to 33 or 45 rotations, so that there is no need to worry about deformation due to the pulley or rim being in the ON state.The cartridge is equipped with M75-6S manufactured by Shure as standard.The auto-changer has a control arm hold records horizontally when they are used with several records. On the 310X, clearance is provided so that this arm does not touch the sound groove.Equipped with a manual arm lock mechanism, the arm does not fly due to vibration and damage the needle tip or record.Equipped with anti-skating mechanism, cancel amount corresponding to cone needle can be set.A walnut cabinet is used for the cabinet."

name: 610X
description: "A 4-speed record player with an auto-changer mechanism.The turntable part uses a 4-pole synchronous motor and a dynamically balanced 1.5 kg turntable.It is designed to be jam proof and has improved durability.For example, if you move the arm carelessly while holding it in your hand, it will interfere with the interlocking mechanism or cause a locked object to fly away. The danger that is often seen with conventional auto players and auto-changers is prevented.The speed selector is designed to automatically turn off at the end of the performance without turning off the speed selector.At this time, the internal mechanism automatically returns to the neutral position even if the position is set to 33 or 45 rotations, so that there is no need to worry about deformation due to the pulley or rim being in the ON state.Sliding type is adopted for the head shell part.The cartridge is equipped with M-93E made of Shure as standard.The auto-changer is equipped with a control arm to fix the record horizontally when it is used with several records. The 610X has a clearance so that this arm does not touch the sound groove. In addition, this control arm is designed to swing away so that it can be turned back up to 90 degrees so that it does not get in the way during single play.Equipped with an automatic arm-lock device, the auto-cut arm returns to the arm rest and locks automatically at the end of the performance. This prevents the arm from flying due to vibration and damaging the needle tip or record.A double-graduated anti-skating mechanism is adopted, and the cancellation amount can be set strictly corresponding to both conical and elliptical needles.Oil dump queuing mechanism has been adopted to realize smooth movement.Equipped with a noise prevention filter.A walnut cabinet is used for the cabinet."

name: 810X
description: "Hi-Fi changer developed by all BSR engineers.Aluminum die-cast turntable is adopted.In addition, a rotating mechanism using 8 cams has been adopted to realize accurate and quiet operation.The cartridge uses M91ED manufactured by Shure.Shell replacement is a slide system.Equipped with a noise filter and muting mechanism to shut out electrical noise.Equipped with a speed adjustment mechanism of ¥3%. Equipped with a strobe disk for speed confirmation.The anti-skating mechanism is equipped with a special cue clutch, and the arm is accurately lowered to the original position by operating the oil dump cue lever.The tone arm is supported by a gimbal with four ball bearings and friction resistance is almost 0.It is equipped with an umbrella type spindle for automatic play and a stub spindle for manual play that rotates with a turntable to prevent damage to the center hole of the record board.All push button system is adopted for the operation part."

name: BSR1000X
description: "As a mini changer, this compact auto-changer can be placed on a bookshelf or in the corner of a small room.Its mechanism is the same as that of a full-size autochanger, and it can play up to six 30-cm discs in succession.Also, when you play a 17 cm record, use the attached 45 rotation adapter.Repeat play and manual play can be performed with one touch operation.The BSR's proven ceramic cartridge is included.Equipped with safety lock mechanism, tone arm can be firmly fixed.The cabinet is a reinforced plastic cabinet made in the United Kingdom.Dust cover is included."

name: 6500X
description: "This record player is the revised model of BSR's C141 changer.The BSR C141 was used in high-end stereo sets around the world.The 6500X takes advantage of the C141 design and realizes a high-class, low-cost model.It uses a combination mechanism of tone arm and control arm, so you can enjoy full auto, manual play and one touch.Needle pressure can be adjusted.A queueing system is adopted.Equipped with anti-skating mechanism.Equipped with British-style shell and BSR rated ceramic cartridge."

name: HT-70MKII
description: "A full-auto player released by BSR as the only player that is not an auto changer.Equipped with a full-auto mechanism, you can perform auto-start, Oatley turn, auto-stop, start of music with oil dump queuing, etc. with one touch lever operation. The power is automatically turned off when the performance ends and the arm is automatically locked.In addition, a jam-proof design has been adopted to prevent failures due to operational errors, thereby suppressing internal failures.An idler drive is used as the drive system.Our 4-pole synchronous motor is used as the drive motor, and the turntable is rotated by a highly reliable idler also manufactured by BSR.A die-cast turntable is used for the turntable.The tone arm is a highly sensitive square arm with tapered bearings, which is resistant to torsion and has low resonance frequencies, enabling clear sound and Yutaka Fukuda bass reproduction.In addition, by adopting a sliding head shell, it is possible to fix the cartridge exactly horizontally while suppressing contact failure and rattling.Equipped with double scale anti-skating mechanism.In this mechanism, the canceling amount of the inside force can be adjusted with one touch according to both types of conical needle (round needle) and elliptic needle.It uses M75-6S, a MM type cartridge made of Shure.Cabinets specially designed and managed by BSR are manufactured and used in Japan.Rosewood finished cabinet with howling protection, acrylic dust cover is thick enough to suppress resonance, and free stop hinge makes it easy to put on and take off.A space is provided on the arm side of the cabinet as a hand protector, and it can be adjusted accurately with your hand when changing the needle or fine-adjusting the arm."
